lead: Omar Abdullah is best known as an Indian politician, born on 10 March 1970 in Rochford.
As of 2026, he is 56 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of member of the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly and Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir.
The sections that follow break down Omar Abdullah's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Omar Abdullah — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Omar Abdullah was born on 10 March 1970 in Rochford, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Farooq Abdullah. He is a sibling of Sara Pilot.
He studied at University of Strathclyde, University of Mumbai, The Lawrence School, Sanawar and Burn Hall School.

sections.heading: Omar Abdullah — Career and Professional Work
paras: Omar Abdullah works primarily as a politician.

He has held the following offices: member of the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly (2009–2018), Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir (2009–2015), Member of the 12th Lok Sabha, Member of the 13th Lok Sabha, Chief Minister of Jammu and Kashmir (2024–present) and member of the Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly (2024–present). He is affiliated with Jammu & Kashmir National Conference.
